m: Brown the mince hard in a big pan. Add the diced onion, capsicum and zucchini and cook 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, oregano and tomato paste for 2 minutes, then the crushed tomatoes. Simmer 15 minutes and season.
Meanwhile cook the pasta 2 minutes short of the packet time. Drain.
Heat oven to 200°C. Mix the pasta through the sauce and tip into a baking dish.
Cover with the cheese and mozzarella. Bake 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.
l: Cut into squares once it cools. Reheats like a dream.
g: Make the GF portion in its own smaller dish with GF pasta.
